summary.key_theme: AWS 的雲端成長與 AI 資本支出帶來的長期潛力，與地緣政治風險及營運中斷挑戰形成多空拉鋸。

bullish.title: Is Amazon Stock a Buy, Hold, or Sell Below $250? — AWS is accelerating at its fastest pace in 18 quarters
bullish.reason: AWS 雲端業務成長速度創下 18 季以來新高，且擁有高達 5,000 億美元的合約積壓，顯示核心業務動能強勁。

bullish.title: Amazon Is Spending $220 Billion on Data Centers. Here's Why That Makes The Stock an Incredible Buy
bullish.reason: 儘管資本支出龐大，但分析認為這些投資能帶來具體的長期回報，支撐股價成長潛力。

bullish.title: What Does Best Buy (BBY) Fire TV Deal Mean For Its Ad Business?
bullish.reason: 與 Best Buy 擴大 Fire TV 廣告合作，有助於強化 Amazon 在聯網電視廣告市場的市占率與變現能力。

bullish.title: Amazon offers one inbound shipment to reach eight countries
bullish.reason: 簡化跨境物流流程，提升賣家使用意願，有助於擴大電商生態系的規模效應。

bullish.title: Amazon copies Costco move that benefits members and workers
bullish.reason: 透過優化會員與員工福利策略，有望提升客戶忠誠度與員工留任率。

bullish.title: Amazon Taps Prysmian and Rio Tinto for Low-Carbon Data Center Cables
bullish.reason: 與供應商合作低碳基礎設施，符合長期 ESG 目標，並確保資料中心建設的供應鏈穩定。

bullish.title: Amazon Expands Multichannel Tools for Sellers
bullish.reason: 新增多通路管理工具，增強賣家對 Amazon 平台的依賴度與營運效率。

bullish.title: Amazon Has No Dividend. Here's Why Long-Term Investors Should Own It Anyway.
bullish.reason: 強調公司資本配置效率高，長期資本增值潛力遠大於發放股息，適合長期投資人。

bearish.title: Amazon.com (AMZN) Confirmed Iranian Drone Strikes Hit AWS Data Centers
bearish.reason: 資料中心遭無人機攻擊屬於重大安全與營運風險，可能影響客戶對 AWS 穩定性的信心。

bearish.title: Amazon (AMZN) Pauses a Cargo Carrier after a Fatal Crash
bearish.reason: 貨運合作夥伴發生致命事故導致營運暫停，可能造成物流網絡短期壓力與額外成本。

bearish.title: Houston, Amazon.com Has a Problem -- and It's in Europe!
bearish.reason: 衛星發射計畫受阻，影響其低軌衛星星座的擴張時程，對長期通訊布局不利。

bearish.title: Anthropic's IPO is a $300 billion test for Amazon
bearish.reason: 作為 Anthropic 的主要投資者，其 IPO 表現將直接影響 Amazon 的帳面價值與戰略布局成效。

bearish.title: Amazon Stock: Is AI Capex Outrunning the Payback?
bearish.reason: 市場擔憂 2,200 億美元的 AI 資本支出過高，若回報速度不及預期，將壓縮自由現金流。

bearish.title: Meta's standoff with Amazon over Muse could be a sign of things to come
bearish.reason: 與 Meta 的衝突凸顯了大型科技公司在 AI 領域的競爭與潛在的反壟斷監管壓力。

bearish.title: Amazon Turned $1,000 Into $5,239 Over Ten Years but Recent Buyers Face a Rougher Reality
bearish.reason: 提醒近期買入的投資人面臨較高的波動與估值壓力，與過去十年的高成長期相比，短期獲利難度增加。

neutral.title: Amazon (AMZN) Calls for AI Safeguards Without a Slowdown
neutral.reason: 呼籲 AI 安全規範但強調不減緩發展，屬於企業公關立場，對股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Seattle tower across from Amazon sold for $12.5M after a $97M deal in 2019
neutral.reason: 反映西雅圖辦公室房地產市場疲軟，雖與 Amazon 總部相關，但對公司核心業務影響有限。

neutral.title: I'd Buy Amazon Stock While It Sits 12% Below Its Record
neutral.reason: 分析師觀點，認為股價折價提供買入機會，屬於市場情緒面分析。

neutral.title: Amazon Opened Seller Central to Walmart and eBay but Blocked Meta’s Muse
neutral.reason: 整合與封鎖並存的策略調整，反映公司在生態系開放性上的權衡。

neutral.title: Let’s Take a Closer Look at Amazon’s (AMZN) Debt-Fueled AI Buildout
neutral.reason: 針對債務融資 AI 建設的討論，屬於中性財務觀察，未有明確利多或利空結論。
